system.description:
This also works like a standard crystal ball, but with the added power to listen to the thoughts of a creature viewed. It is only usable by a magic-user.

This item can only be used by an elf or a magic-user. Its owner may look into it and see any place or object thought about as it exists at that time. It will work three times per day, and the image will last for 1 turn. Spells cannot be cast "through" the crystal ball. The more familiar the object or area to be seen, the clearer the picture will be.
